messages.transfer_task_card_text_0033: Stops further uploads. Uploaded files are kept.
messages.transfer_task_card_text_0037: Continuing cancellation only handles local files: finishes files already being written, keeps downloaded and saved files, and removes temporary downloads. No further network downloads.
messages.transfer_task_card_text_0038: Continuing cancellation checks publication online, restores unpublished remote files and cleans up this task's temporary files. If a target has changed, cancellation stops; the target, recovery copies and temporary files are kept. Published uploads only continue cleanup.
messages.transfer_task_card_text_0039: Continuing cancellation checks whether deletion took effect and restores content if it didn't. If the original path is occupied, both copies are kept for resolution.
messages.transfer_task_card_text_0040: Retry checks original files and recovery copies, then continues the confirmed deletion scope.
messages.transfer_task_card_text_0041: Retry checks uploaded content and recovery copies, then resumes the original task. Confirmed metadata won't be published twice.
messages.transfer_task_card_text_0042: Downloaded and saved files are kept. Incomplete downloads restart.
